description: CPU personalities (story-011). Each entry layers a play style on top of whichever difficulty level the CPU uses (assets/data/ai_difficulty.json). Keys are the snake_case form of the ai_difficulty.json level and behaviour keys (throw_chance = throwChance). 'scale' multiplies the level/behaviour value (>= 0; 1 = unchanged), then 'set' replaces it outright. Level probabilities are clamped to 0..1 after scaling; the result is re-validated for every level at load. Locked keys (reaction_frames, decision_frames, mistake_rate, plan_jitter_frames, reach_margin, threat_margin, ring_edge_margin) are the fairness rules and the level's skill tier and may not appear here: a personality changes style, never reaction delay or what the CPU can see. The map key is the personalityId referenced by assets/data/arcade_ladder.json; display names are player-facing copy and live in src/ui/strings.js PERSONALITY_TEXT keyed by that id (no 'name' field here); 'summary' is a designer note. Tuning (2026-11-04, production/session-logs/decision-log.md): each profile at Normal wins 30-70% vs the default Normal CPU on either fighter (node tools/balance-sim.mjs --seeds 400 --pairs normal/<id>:normal,normal:normal/<id>), and every pair stays >= 0.20 apart in the 60 s action mix (tests/ai/cpu-personalities.test.js); win rate follows the neutral offence share (aggression vs the wait/back-off/guard weights), not block, throw or heavy shares. Loaded and validated by src/ai/personalities.js.

rusher.summary: Pressure and grabs: walks in, jabs instead of swinging heavies, throws a guarding opponent far more often, rarely waits or backs off.

turtle.summary: Shells up: guards pre-emptively in your range, blocks and whiff-punishes more, waits for you to commit rather than starting things.

trickster.summary: Spins around you: sidesteps in neutral and against attacks, mixes in specials and low pokes, presses a little harder than the default.

showboat.summary: Struts and swings big heavies, saves its Temper for an Overforge comeback when it is losing.
